# KF 4.1 — Server Routes auto-generated

To prevent API keys from leaking to client-side JS bundles, the module automatically maps these internal server endpoints:

## Endpoints List
- `GET /api/_gsheet/values/:range` - Fetch data.
- `POST /api/_gsheet/append` - Append new row.
- `PUT /api/_gsheet/update` - Update range cell values.
- `DELETE /api/_gsheet/clear` - Reset cell values.
